title: Integral chart isomorphisms determine ordinary datum pullback isomorphisms
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d, a scheme morphism g:S→T and a pro-etale chart U of S, an isomorphism between the integralLocalDerived restrictions of two arbitrary complexes K,L over d.completedRing T gives an isomorphism between their ordinary datum pullbacks along U.hom followed by g. No immersion, Noetherian scheme or perfect model hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11; Lemmas 6.5.8 and 6.6.8, with the recorded completed coefficient comparisons.

proof.text: Normalize the given slice isomorphism by scalar restriction along the inverse-image coefficient isomorphism. The pro-etale slice equivalence is fully faithful on derived categories. Apply its inverse on isomorphisms and the datum pullback compositor to obtain an isomorphism between the two ordinary datum pullbacks to U.left. This comparison needs no pullback compatibility of constant realization.

lean.statement:
theorem integralLocalDerived_pullbackIso {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (U : S.ProEt)
    (K L : d.derived T)
    (h : integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T d) U K ≅
      integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T d) U L) :
    Nonempty ((d.pull (U.hom ≫ g)).obj K ≅ (d.pull (U.hom ≫ g)).obj L)
